tbesh_subentries.definition_html:
1) to glorify, beautify, adorn
1a) (Piel) to glorify, beautify
1b) (Hithpael)
1b1) to glorify oneself
1b2) to get glory to oneself, be glorified

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to gleam, i.e. (causatively) embellish; figuratively, to boast; also to explain (i.e. make clear) oneself; to shake a tree
strongs_1890.derivation: a primitive root; also denominative from H6288 (פְּאֹרָה),
strongs_1890.kjv_def: beautify, boast self, go over the boughs, glorify (self), glory, vaunt self.
